title: Whole-slide deep learning distinguishes germinoma, oligodendroglioma and astrocytoma
summary: A tile-level deep learning classifier with majority voting was developed on 500 frozen and 832 HE-stained sections from 379 patients. Internal accuracy was 93.9% (frozen) and 95.3% (HE), but external validation accuracy was 82.0% and 76.9%. The models predicted Ki-67 positive area (R2 0.81 and 0.86), and model assistance raised pathologists' accuracy from 54.6-69.7% to 87.9-93.9% for frozen sections. Retrospective; external accuracy is markedly lower than internal.
ai_technology: Tile-level deep learning classification of whole-slide images with majority voting
organization: University of Science and Technology of China; Suzhou Institute of Biomedical Engineering and Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences

evidence.tested: Internal validation and external validation at other centers; assisted-reader comparison with pathologists.
evidence.unknown: Prospective clinical benefit is not established; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Deep learning classified tumor type and predicted Ki-67 area on digitized slides.
